decision_skill.name: robust_baseline_ensemble
decision_skill.description: Combine recent-level persistence, damped local drift, and repeated-lag shape when simple signals retain usefulness across historical folds and their disagreement represents uncertainty.
decision_skill.applicability: When forecasting a time series with uncertain regime continuity and no consistently superior complex pattern model.
decision_skill.decision_rule: Select the robust ensemble when its components remain useful across most fixed-origin validation folds and harmonic or phase-based alternatives do not demonstrate stable, repeatable superiority.
decision_skill.failure_condition: Do not use when validation shows a persistent regime break, a reliably recurring phase structure, or another candidate with robust superiority across representative folds.
